# PPLGYM_SAMPLE  — forward semi-Markov walk w/ momentum (semiMarkovWalk(6,1) = 6 states = 2 inits + 4 transitions)
function walk_end()
    s2 = Gen.random(normal, 200.0, 1.0)      # init state 1
    s1 = Gen.random(normal, 200.0, 1.0)      # init state 2
    for _ in 1:4
        mom = (s1 - s2) * 0.7
        snew = Gen.random(normal, s1 + mom, 3.0)
        s2 = s1; s1 = snew
    end
    return s1 > 200.0                         # last state (6)
end

    return (offer / 10.0) ^ alpha
end

@gen function round2_model(alpha2::Float64)
    offer2 = ({:offer2} ~ uniform_discrete(0, 10))
    p2 = accept_prob(Float64(offer2), alpha2)
    accepted2 = ({:accepted2} ~ bernoulli(p2))
    reward2 = accepted2 ? (10.0 - offer2) : 0.0
    ({:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(reward2))
    return offer2
end

function run_round2_offer(alpha2::Float64, n_inner::Int)
    obs = choicemap((:pot, 0.0))
    (tr, _) = generate(round2_model, (alpha2,), obs)
    offers = Int[]
    for it in 1:n_inner
        (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(:offer2))
        (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(:accepted2))
        push!(offers, tr[:offer2])
    end
    return offers[rand(1:length(offers))]
end

function run_ultimatum_round2(n_alpha_samples::Int, n_outer::Int, n_inner::Int)
    alpha_samples = run_alpha_posterior(n_alpha_samples)
    round2_offers = Int[]
    for _ in 1:n_outer
        alpha2 = alpha_samples[rand(1:length(alpha_samples))]
        push!(round2_offers, run_round2_offer(alpha2, n_inner))
    end
    return round2_offers

struct CausalTrial
    C::Bool
    E::Bool
end

function make_dataset(num_e_with_c::Int, num_e_without_c::Int)
    trials = CausalTrial[]
    for _ in 1:num_e_with_c;            push!(trials, CausalTrial(true,  true));  end
    for _ in 1:(8 - num_e_with_c);      push!(trials, CausalTrial(true,  false)); end
    for _ in 1:num_e_without_c;         push!(trials, CausalTrial(false, true));  end
    for _ in 1:(8 - num_e_without_c);   push!(trials, CausalTrial(false, false)); end
    return trials
end

                      (8,4),(6,2),(4,0),(8,2),(6,0),(8,0)]

@gen function cp_model(trials::Vector{CausalTrial})
    cp = ({:cp} ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    b  = ({:b}  ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    for (i, t) in enumerate(trials)
        p = noisy_or_p(t.C, cp, b)
        ({(:E, i)} ~ bernoulli(p))
    end
    return cp
end

@gen function cs_model(trials::Vector{CausalTrial})
    relation = ({:relation} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    cp = ({:cp} ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    b  = ({:b}  ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    for (i, t) in enumerate(trials)
        active = relation && t.C
        p = noisy_or_p(active, cp, b)
        ({(:E, i)} ~ bernoulli(p))
    end
    return relation ? cp : 0.0
end

function run_cp_mean(trials::Vector{CausalTrial}, burn::Int, n_samples::Int, lag::Int)
    obs = choicemap()
    for (i, t) in enumerate(trials)
        obs[(:E, i)] = t.E
    end
    (tr, _) = generate(cp_model, (trials,), obs)
    addrs = Any[:cp, :b]
    total = burn + n_samples * lag
    cps = Float64[]
    for it in 1:total
        for a in addrs
            (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(a))
        end
        if it > burn && it % lag == 0
            push!(cps, tr[:cp])
        end
    end
    return mean(cps)
end

function run_cs_mean(trials::Vector{CausalTrial}, burn::Int, n_samples::Int, lag::Int)
    obs = choicemap()
    for (i, t) in enumerate(trials)
        obs[(:E, i)] = t.E
    end
    (tr, _) = generate(cs_model, (trials,), obs)
    addrs = Any[:relation, :cp, :b]
    total = burn + n_samples * lag
    vals = Float64[]
    for it in 1:total
        for a in addrs
            (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(a))
        end
        if it > burn && it % lag == 0
            push!(vals, tr[:relation] ? tr[:cp] : 0.0)
        end
    end
    return mean(vals)
end
